Minister KTR's car hit by truck in Telangana, no injuries reported

Telangana Minister K. T. Rama Rao (KTR) was involved in a road incident near Karimnagar when a truck collided with his car. The collision occurred when the truck hit the rear door of KTR's vehicle. No injuries were reported for the minister or anyone else involved in the incident. The minister's car sustained damage as a result of the impact.
